name: com.nabagame.reward
description: Reusable reward features for NabaGame projects: Daily Reward, Online Reward (timed grid with x2/x5 ad speed-up), Lucky Spin. Game-agnostic: reward payouts, audio, and ads are provided by the host game through a small hooks contract. See Documentation~ for architecture and integration guides.

samples.description: Runnable demo of Daily Reward and Lucky Spin: two scenes, panel + template prefabs, sample RewardItem/config assets, home buttons with red-dot badges, and a SampleRewardGranter showing how a host maps RewardItem.Key onto its own economy.
